name: Tabular ICL research and implementation v4 — concrete reference-derived candidate
status: Runnable recommended candidate; local mathematical, learned-head and integration checks; no competitive pretraining or GPU calibration
inference_contract: Frozen weights; labeled support conditions query predictions. Ensembles/retrieval are separate inference settings; task fine-tuning is a separate comparator.
configuration_precedence: main_candidate below, configs/candidate_standard.json, configs/candidate_fraud.json and docs/main_recipe.md define the current recommendation. Older flat prior/curriculum/candidate_model/default_training fields document the authored control and remain for reproducible comparisons. Runtime configs are bounded pilots, not full-volume launch files. Research-only arms are not trainer flags.

default_training.episodes_per_world: standard=1;finance=4; at most one per logical batch
default_training.validity_failure_policy: Authored sampler fails fast; ordered process producer does not replace draws. Native R retains its explicit upstream rejection loops and abort bound.

curriculum.class_support_floor: n_support=max(sampled_n_support,16*K); a context-complexity choice, not required by known-vocabulary masking. Log actual sizes.
curriculum.width_condition: After class floor/query count, renormalize width probabilities over (n_support+n_query)*width<=stage_cell_cap. No silent feature removal.
curriculum.late_stage_gate: Only execute if memory/throughput and development gains support it; otherwise preregister continuation on the best confirmed shape mixture.
curriculum.width_bucket_rule: Use the sampled shape bucket even after the class-dependent support floor; then condition on cell cap.
curriculum.wide_bucket_reason: A width of1024 is impossible with ns>=8193 under2^23 cells. Separate medium-row wide tasks give that width actual training mass.

optional_experiments.context_v1: 90% context-capped tasks /10% exact base replay; static JSON defines caps
optional_experiments.conditional_label_loss: 0/50/100% replacement on valid forward-classification worlds; hard support remains. SCM disabled. Full-loss conditional regression resampling K=4 is separate.
optional_experiments.adaptive_sampling: Fixed independent diagnostic worlds; current PFN loss vs portfolio, same sampled support shape, q=min256,max16,ns//4; every2%budget; details in assessment.
optional_experiments.world_reuse: 4 episodes per world, at most one per logicalbatch, uniform reuse count; report distinctworlds and changedgradientcorrelation.
optional_experiments.real_data_continuation: Replace5% episodes with lineage-disjoint development real-data tasks; retain synthetic-only checkpoint; no lockedbenchmarkdata.

scaling_runs.main_sizes: two sizes in the selected architecture family; no initial1B allocation
scaling_runs.horizon_policy: Completed schedules; final12kh ceiling still extrapolates4x beyond3kh bridge, so conditional on sustained per-task progress; no confident compute-optimal claim

compute.throughput: CPU smoke measured only; no MI355X profile or learning curve. Full index/generation and routed prefills must be charged.

allocation.description: R; R plus observation O; R/H15; R/forest20; R/smooth10; R/interaction05; full Q with identity; full Q with O. Individual mechanism arms use identity observation. Two seeds per arm;300 GPU-hours per seed package.

Graph anchors .70,.50,.30 with remaining4:3:2:1 mechanism ratios; same chosen observation mode. A predeclared dimension/filter intervention may replace one slot, never add an uncharged slot. Failed component exclusion changes candidate identity and must be recorded before launch. Use fresh seed indices2/3, rather than rerun the identical R50 seed0/1 endpoints from phaseP.

R and selected challenger on authored compressed and compact persistent-cell backbones; identical output contracts. Two seeds per cell;400 hours each. Equal-cost system comparison, not topology-only attribution. Compact backbone remains unimplemented.

Reference and complete finalist, two fresh seeds each;700 hours/run. Mixture hyperparameters frozen before confirmation data access. Include standard slices and prediction/setup latency. Use seed indices4/5, absent from P/M/A; these are new confirmation seeds.

Common chosen standard parent: continued standard replay, fraud reservoir+observed-positives, fraud full selector. Fresh optimizer, same peak LR convention and400 hour ceiling; two seeds. Both fraud arms hide H from model and selector and use correct population weights. This replaces the earlier six-finance-arm screen; it is not additional spending. Use seed indices6/7 with paired continuation initialization.

previous_screening_detail.factorial_prior_rule: R and ONE graft that survives prior triage; a full replacement may substitute only by recorded selection. If none survives, retainR and do not force a secondprior or spend unusedallocation.
previous_screening_detail.finance_policy: F3/F4 retain F2 weighting/selector and differ only in stated intervention. F5 normalizer selected before run; final confirmation refits its paired full-selector control. All normalizations retain correct population proposal weights. V two slots include the refitted paired control; no third configuration is funded.
previous_screening_detail.short_runs: Triage only. Expensive comparisons require measured enough updates and completed curriculum; reduce scope before launch if infeasible.
previous_screening_detail.fresh_control_policy: Funded pairs use completed matched horizons, not partial checkpoints from longer decays.
previous_screening_detail.confirmation_policy: At most two complete configurations, INCLUDING the necessary paired control, each with two new seeds. All standard and finance panels; gains not assumed additive; no third uncharged control.
previous_screening_detail.family_comparison_scope: Different family parameter counts allowed for equal-cost system comparison; not pure topology attribution.
previous_screening_detail.status: Superseded; retained historical design, not additional budget.

primary: locked chronological natural-prevalence finance periods versus full-history tuned trees
evaluation.information: Inductive support-only preprocessing, legal training-only vocabulary, no query-label selection
evaluation.uncertainty: Dataset-lineage blocked paired analysis, seed variation and multiplicity

evaluation.latency: Cold-context total GPU batch time is primary; report cached-query time, component costs, median/p95, throughput and peak memory separately. No silent context truncation.

main_candidate.p1_rule: Independent 0.05 branch after task/shape draw; requested F>=8; ineligible mass returns to R; observed counts are random
main_candidate.reference_representation_limit: Native encoded features have no nominal type flags; hash-bit training comes primarily from P1 and typed finance tasks. Realized classes and width may shrink.
main_candidate.world_count_condition: Completed schedule without skipped updates, replayed attempts or stage-crossing reuse groups; not independent positives
main_candidate.volume_status: Explicit provisional targets. Complete stage throughput and reserved overhead determine feasible smaller fixed horizons; no MI355X measurement exists.
main_candidate.checkpoint_policy: Protect standard weights; initialize separate binary fraud specialist with fresh optimizer and schedule. Shared80/20 is a control.
main_candidate.producer: One persistent spawned CPU process per rank, bounded ordered task queue; serial replay tested; no pinned transfer stream or measured GPU utilization
main_candidate.query_cache: 2 query KV heads, full support KV heads; storage improvement does not imply equal attention FLOP/latency reduction
main_candidate.status: Executable reference-derived pilot; superseded as a final-bank recommendation by prior_selection_v1.json; runtime configs unchanged.
